subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
outcomes: Use words like ancient, culture, citizen and archaeologist.
Listen for facts about ancient civilisations.

tf.s: A civilisation is the culture and way of life of a society at a particular time.
tf.why: Yes, that is the meaning of civilisation.

tf.s: The Ancient Egyptians built the pyramids.
An archaeologist is a person who studies old objects and buildings.
tf.why: Right, archaeologists learn about the past.

tf.s: The Majan civilisation was known for copper and shipbuilding.
tf.why: Well done, Majan was famous for these.

tf.s: Greek civilisation was known for building the pyramids.
tf.why: Greek civilisation was known for philosophy and architecture.

tf.s: A citizen is a person who studies old buildings.
tf.why: That is an archaeologist; a citizen belongs to a country or city.

tf.s: Egyptian civilisation lasted from about 3000 BC to 30 BC.
tf.why: Correct, this is from the listening.

tf.s: Greek civilisation lasted from about 800 BC to 146 BC.
tf.why: Yes, that was in the table.

tf.s: A leader is a person who follows everyone else.
tf.why: A leader guides a group of people.

boxes.why: Majan traded copper and built ships.
The Greeks are famous for ideas and buildings.

boxes.q: A person who studies old objects and buildings is…

boxes.why: Ancient things are from long ago.

boxes.q: A person who guides a group is…
Beliefs and worship of a people are their…

boxes.why: Civilisation means a way of life.

hunt.q: Way of life of a society

o: the culture and way of life of a society at a particular time
mcq.why: Civilisation describes how a society lived.

mcq.q: Which civilisation was known for copper and shipbuilding?
mcq.why: Majan is linked to Oman's ancient past.
Archaeologists learn about the past from objects.

mcq.q: When did Egyptian civilisation last, according to the listening?
Complete: ______ studied the old tools found in the desert.
mcq.why: Studying old objects is an archaeologist's job.

mcq.q: A temple shows what people believed. Which word describes this?
Complete: Greek civilisation was known for ______.
mcq.why: The Greeks are famous for ideas and buildings.

mcq.q: Which lasted longer: Egyptian (3000 BC–30 BC) or Greek (800 BC–146 BC) civilisation?
mcq.why: Egyptian lasted about 2970 years; Greek about 654 years.

mcq.q: Which answer gives an opinion with a reason?
o: I find the Sumerians interesting because they invented writing.
mcq.why: A good opinion gives a reason with 'because'.

mcq.q: Why are the Majan civilisation's copper and ships important for Oman's history?
o: They show that ancient Oman made and traded goods.
They show Oman had no people.
mcq.why: Copper and ships point to trade.
